meta.name: exploratory-data-analysis
meta.description: Perform bounded, local exploratory analysis of explicitly supported scientific files. Use for redacted CSV/TSV/JSON profiles; optional NumPy, HDF5, FASTA/FASTQ, and basic image metadata inspection; missingness/leakage audits; outlier and transformation sensitivity; and rigorous EDA report scaffolds. Other domain formats are reference-only and unknown formats fail closed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对科学数据进行探索性分析并生成报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速分析科学数据集并发现异常
copy.tagline_en: Perform exploratory analysis on scientific data and generate reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly analyze scientific datasets and detect anomalies

howto.what: Claude 对你给的科学数据文件做有限本地探索:识别格式(CSV/TSV/JSON、NumPy、HDF5、FASTA/FASTQ、图像),查缺失、泄漏、异常,输出 markdown 报告,含质量指标与建议。其他格式仅参考,未知会失败关闭。
howto.when: 当用户给出科学数据文件路径,或要求“探索/分析/总结”文件,或询问数据质量与后续分析时触发。

say.text: 分析一下这个 data.csv 文件
say.note: Claude 会识别 CSV 并生成 EDA 报告。

say.text: 检查 reads.fastq 的数据质量
say.note: 会做序列长度、GC含量、质量分数等检查。

say.text: 看看这份实验数据有没有缺失或泄漏
say.note: 会做缺失/泄漏审计并给出建议。

howto.what_en: Claude does bounded local EDA on scientific files you give: detects format (CSV/TSV/JSON, NumPy, HDF5, FASTA/FASTQ, images), checks missingness, leakage, outliers, and outputs a markdown report with quality metrics and suggestions. Other formats are reference-only; unknown fail closed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a path to a scientific data file, asks to 'explore'/'analyze'/'summarize' a file, or asks about data quality and next-step analysis.

say_en.note: Claude will detect the format and generate an EDA report.

say_en.text: Check the data quality of reads.fastq.
say_en.note: It will inspect read counts, length, GC content, quality scores.

say_en.text: See if this experiment has missing data or leakage.
say_en.note: It will audit missingness/leakage and give suggestions.
